burnish.line: His back was burnished red and gold
burnish.lineNext: And every time he closed his eyes a rooster crowed
stanza: His back was burnished red and gold
And every time he closed his eyes a rooster crowed
He sowed a hundred rows of corn
And wondered what your life would yield

furnish.line: They show me rooms furnished with gold
furnish.lineNext: And then they close the doors
stanza: They want me bad, now bad I'll be
They feed me with desires for
Things that I don't need or want
Stick their needles in my arms
They show me rooms furnished with gold
And then they close the doors
